stable_dna.visual_background: East-Asian-looking woman with a globally neutral original identity and no resemblance to a specific real person

face.shape: slim, slightly elongated oval face with a gently narrow and softly tapered lower face, never a sharp V-line
face.eyes: large, soft, slightly elongated dark-brown eyes that never read wide-set, with relaxed eyelids and a calm coordinated gaze
face.eyebrows: natural softly defined dark eyebrows with slightly narrow brow-to-brow and glabella spacing
face.nose: small refined nose with soft, balanced and believable proportions, not a celebrity-specific likeness
face.lips: soft rose-beige lips, gently closed, with delicate natural volume, understated realistic texture and a natural satin finish
face.jaw: gently narrow, softly tapered and balanced lower face, never an exaggerated sharp V-line

body.height_impression: tall-looking with a natural slender silhouette, long legs and a relatively compact torso
body.limb_proportions: long-legged with anatomically normal arms; natural shoulder-to-elbow and elbow-to-wrist lengths, wrists around upper-thigh level when relaxed, and natural hand size
body.shoulders: slim natural shoulder line without exaggerated width or fragility
body.torso: relatively compact, slim, healthy and believable torso; never fragile, skeletal or bodybuilder-toned
body.bust: natural adult proportion that is not a defining identity trait and remains consistent across scenes
body.waist: natural narrow slender waist without exaggerated glamour shaping
body.pelvis_hips: natural feminine proportion without excessive curves as a defining trait
body.lower_body: healthy slender lower-body silhouette with long legs and realistic full-body anatomy; never shortened legs or stretched fashion-model proportions
body.body_hair: natural and not an identity-defining feature

stable_dna.hair: long near-black hair with soft natural texture and soft full bangs across the forehead; lived-in rather than salon-perfect, with natural root volume, grouped strands, a few separated fibers, baby hairs, subtle flyaways, realistic overlap and gravity-driven fall
stable_dna.skin: very clear, fresh, translucent-looking pale skin with subtle inner luminosity, realistic fine pores, soft natural texture, faint natural blood tone and gentle cheek color, smooth highlight roll-off and minimal everyday base makeup; never waxy, porcelain-like, glossy or beauty-filter smoothed
distinctive_marks: on her RIGHT wrist, exactly three very thin handmade ethnic knot bracelets stacked together, each using repeating small red and blue knots; delicate, personal, slightly worn and never luxurious or chunky
recognition_anchors: slim slightly elongated oval face with gently narrow but non-V-line lower face
slightly narrow brow-to-brow and glabella spacing
large soft slightly elongated dark-brown eyes
fresh translucent pale minimal-makeup skin with visible fine pores and natural texture
soft rose-beige gently closed satin-finish lips
long near-black naturally textured hair with soft full lived-in bangs
tall slender long-legged silhouette with compact torso and anatomically normal arms
exactly three thin red-and-blue knotted bracelets on the right wrist
globally neutral original identity with no real-person resemblance

scene_defaults.expression: faint, quiet, warm and unposed natural smile; never exaggerated or influencer-like
scene_defaults.makeup: minimal everyday base makeup with realistic skin texture
scene_defaults.gaze: calm coordinated gaze with both eyes sharing one target; direct when posed, brief and understated during candid activity
scene_defaults.public_wardrobe: practical and easygoing clothing such as a T-shirt, jeans, easy pants, simple shorts or work uniform
scene_defaults.private_homewear: unexpectedly feminine but believable personal loungewear using soft ivory, pale blush or faded floral fabric, delicate lace or ruffles; never cosplay, stagewear or glamour editorial styling
scene_defaults.walking_behavior: head upright and aligned with neck and spine, shoulders aligned with travel, eyes mostly forward, at most a brief 10–15 degree sideways camera glance, chin level or slightly lowered, faint smile

hair_states.home: long near-black hair worn loose with soft full lived-in bangs, natural root volume, grouped strands, baby hairs and subtle flyaways
hair_states.work: long near-black hair gathered into a practical ponytail with natural full bangs
hair_states.wash: long near-black hair tied or twisted up for washing or bathing
hair_states.cafe: signature hair clip holding part of the front hair or bangs for café, reading or phone scenes
